user.title: Create a merged calendar
user.description: Pick the calendars you want combined into one. Add this integration again to make more groups (for example one for everything and one just for sports).

data_description.name: Shows up as the name of the new calendar, like "All Calendars" or "Sports".
data_description.days_ahead: How far ahead the Upcoming events sensor looks. Calendar cards can still browse any date.
data_description.update_interval: How often to re-read your source calendars.
data_description.deduplicate: If the same event (same title and time) is on more than one calendar, show it once.
